narrative.overview:
Soft rounded surfaces, warm dimensional artwork and original duotone marks make career preparation feel approachable. Deep purple anchors readable actions and headings; turquoise, peach, pinks, olive and lavender give supporting surfaces their character. White navigation and pale paper keep forms, status history and real work queues easy to scan. The navigation rail can collapse to make more room, while sign-in pairs a full campus illustration with the native account form.

The user's supplied job-app screenshots and nine-color palette replace the earlier green identity. The reusable signature combines four original task-specific transparent dimensional scenes, a fifth full-scene sign-in illustration, a rounded book logo, custom task icons and clear native controls. Student discovery gives imagery a stronger role through illustrated category tiles and real opportunity cards; company, instructor and administrator work retains its existing task-focused structure. Imagery welcomes people into the product; actual role work and its next action remain legible beside it. The North Star is descriptive language for this implementation, not a claim of separately approved brand strategy.
keyCharacteristics: Rounded, welcoming surfaces with restrained tonal depth.
Deep-purple text and actions supported by the user-pinned pastel palette.
Distinct dimensional learning, opportunity and application artwork with custom duotone task icons.
Real role work, readable status and direct next actions.

rules.name: The Readable Action Rule
rules.body: Use deep purple with white for the main action; lighter palette colors need a measured readable foreground before they carry text.

rules.name: The Written Status Rule
rules.body: Always name a status in text; its tint and dot only reinforce the label.

rules.name: The Native Words Rule
rules.body: Keep headings, labels, errors and action text as HTML; the illustration contains no interface wording.

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: Let rounded tonal surfaces and artwork carry depth; keep work panels flat at rest.

rules: Collapsed navigation labels remain visible while hovered and dismiss with Escape without moving focus.
dos: **Do** preserve the user's rounded, illustrated job-app direction and nine-color palette.
**Do** anchor readable actions and headings in deep purple, with pale secondary surfaces.
**Do** use the distinct original artwork for its task and keep custom task icons consistent.
**Do** preserve the student discovery hierarchy and horizontal mobile opportunity cards within that surface.
**Do** pair real role work with clear next actions, written statuses and Asia/Manila dates.
**Do** keep introduction entry, skip, back and replay controls visible and usable.
**Do** preserve labels, keyboard focus, reduced motion and recoverable task states.
**Do** keep the desktop rail toggle reachable and the mobile drawer full width within its established (280px) size.
**Do** use the full-scene sign-in artwork with native branding, form headings and the documented mobile crop.
donts: **Don't** restore the obsolete green identity as the primary visual direction.
**Don't** use light palette colors for small text without measuring contrast.
**Don't** copy reference wording errors, inactive controls, fictional salaries, partner logos or invented job counts.
**Don't** treat decorative student artwork as participant evidence or a hiring promise.
**Don't** replace actual application history, private-file controls or authorization with decorative UI.
